name: h1h2_ff3g_freeform_h1
command: mkdir -p logs/h1h2 && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True python -m scripts.evaluation.train_h1h2_mask --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --datatype list[str] --n_pairs 512 --l_read 40 --lambda_sparse 5 --n_epochs 32 --seed 123 --intervention free_form --hypotheses h1 --batch_size 8 |& tee logs/h1h2/real_freeform_h1.log
